title: CorrelationPerformed
description: A cross-domain correlation was performed through the resolution endpoint. Audit class, seven years, append-only, and therefore carries no pseudonym: the pids correlated are recorded separately by correlation-detail-recorded under evidential retention and access logging. Emitted before the result is returned. There is no configuration in which this is silent and there is no bulk mode.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier. The join to the evidential detail record, resolvable to a person only while that record survives.

domain_a.description: First domain in the correlation. Only domains that carry pseudonyms can appear: traffic and telemetry are anonymous and vision uses track_ref. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

domain_b.description: Second domain in the correlation. Only domains that carry pseudonyms can appear: traffic and telemetry are anonymous and vision uses track_ref. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

purpose_code.description: Registered purpose code the action was bound to.

principal_b.description: Second authorising principal. MUST differ from principal_a.

legal_basis_ref.description: Reference to the legal basis for the action.

expires_at.description: When the authorisation for this correlation expires.

outcome.description: Result of the correlation. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
